name: Shin Sug-ok
bio: Shin Sug-ok (신숙옥 / 辛淑玉) is a prominent Korean-Japanese entrepreneur, human rights activist, feminist, and prolific author. Born on January 16, 1959, in Tokyo, Japan, she belongs to the third generation of the Zainichi community (permanent Korean residents in Japan). Her life and her intense legal battles against structural racism and hate speech in Japanese society are the focus of the acclaimed feature-length documentary *Horoomon* (2025), directed by Lee Il-ha.

credits.title: Horoomon
credits.overview: One woman. One racist lie. One lawsuit that shook Japan. Korean Japanese entrepreneur Shin Sugok takes on major media in this electro-shock legal thriller about refusing to be silenced.
